mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of declining retail sales (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, which increases corporate output and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly lower when both signals are triggered (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2% YoY) coupled with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 1%) signals a supportive monetary policy, which encourages investment and consumption, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of low inflation and low interest rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% year-over-year signals a strengthening demand side, which increases construction activity and related industries' earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter signals a strengthening economy, which increases corporate revenues and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
